ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( REGEX( Tax_Id__c , ".*-.*"), REGEX(Tax_Id__c, "^0+$") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Your Tax Id can not contain a "-" or only 0's. Please adjust. If you believe this account truly doesn't have a Tax / VAT / GST / etc Id, please submit Salesforce Jira ticket
